stories.title: Temizlik yaparken elektrik akımına kapılan 20 yaşındaki kadın hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 20-year-old woman dies after electric shock while cleaning
en.summary: A 20-year-old woman in Germencik, Aydın died after water contacted a three-outlet power strip she was holding while cleaning her home. An investigation into the incident has been initiated.

stories.title: 15 yaşındaki çocuk, 35 yaşındaki erkeği bıçaklayarak öldürdü

en.title: 15-year-old boy kills 35-year-old man by stabbing
en.summary: A 15-year-old Azerbaijani boy fatally stabbed a 35-year-old man after an argument in Pamukkale, Denizli. The suspect fled but was later captured and detained pending investigation.

stories.title: Eskişehir’deki festivalde organizasyon skandalı: Ceza ve İrem Derici konseri iptal etti, esnaf mağdur oldu

en.title: Organizational scandal at Eskişehir festival: Ceza and İrem Derici cancel concerts, merchants suffer losses
en.summary: Performers Ceza and İrem Derici cancelled their concerts at an Eskişehir food festival after the organizing company failed to meet its responsibilities. Vendors from across Turkey suffered thousands of lira in losses due to cancellations and event disruptions; the event organizer was taken to police headquarters.

en.title: Trump: Very big things will happen
en.summary: US President Donald Trump stated he may meet with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, indicating significant developments could occur.

stories.title: Trump'tan İran için 3 farklı senaryo: "Çok yakında çok büyük şeyler olacak"

en.title: Trump outlines 3 different scenarios for Iran: "Very big things coming very soon"
en.summary: US President Donald Trump indicated he is deciding on Iran policy, with three options under consideration ranging from reaching a deal to complete elimination or economic collapse of the country.

stories.title: Dini nikah tartışması kanlı bitti; 7 bıçak darbesiyle öldürüldü

en.title: Religious marriage dispute ends fatally; killed with 7 knife wounds
en.summary: A man in Denizli's Pamukkale district fatally stabbed the sister of a disabled woman he had married in a religious ceremony during an argument.

stories.title: 15 yaşındaki çocuk, yolda tartıştığı adamı öldürdü

en.title: 15-year-old child killed a man he argued with on the street
en.summary: A 15-year-old Azerbaijani national fatally stabbed a 35-year-old man following a dispute in Pamukkale district of Denizli; the perpetrator was later apprehended by police.

stories.title: 15 yaşındaki çocuk yolda tartıştığı kişiyi öldürdü

en.title: 15-year-old child killed a person he argued with on the street
en.summary: A 15-year-old Azerbaijani national stabbed and killed a 35-year-old man during a street dispute in Denizli.

stories.title: Pamukkale'de gece yarısı tartışma kanlı bitti: 15 yaşındaki çocuk, yolda tartıştığı kişiyi bıçakla öldürdü

en.title: Midnight argument turns deadly in Pamukkale: 15-year-old kills person in street dispute with knife
en.summary: A 35-year-old man was fatally stabbed during a street argument in Pamukkale district that escalated into a fight. A 15-year-old foreign national suspect fled the scene but was later apprehended by police.

stories.title: Vedat Muriqi 4 golle yıldızlaştı: Fenerbahçe, Eyüpspor'u tarihi skorla mağlup etti

en.title: Vedat Muriqi shines with 4 goals: Fenerbahçe defeats Eyüpspor with historic score
en.summary: Fenerbahçe won a Super League match against visiting Eyüpspor with an 8-0 victory, earning three points. Player Vedat Muriqi scored four goals in the match.

stories.title: Temizlik yaparken balkondan düşen kadın hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Woman dies after falling from balcony while cleaning
en.summary: A woman lost her balance while cleaning her balcony on the fifth floor of her apartment in Zeytinburnu and fell to her death.

stories.title: Bisikletiyle park halindeki minibüse çarpan 16 yaşındaki çocuk hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 16-year-old boy dies after bicycle crashes into parked minibus
en.summary: A teenager lost control of his bicycle and collided with a parked minibus in Manisa's Yunusemre district. Despite hospitalization and medical intervention, the youth could not be saved.

stories.title: Amed Sportif Faaliyetler-Beşiktaş maçının ilk 11'leri belli oldu

en.title: Starting lineups announced for Amed Sportif Faaliyetler-Beşiktaş match
en.summary: The starting lineups for the matchup between Amed Sportif Faaliyetler and Beşiktaş in the 6th week of Trendyol Super League have been confirmed.

stories.title: KKTC'den egemen eşitlik ve statü çağrısı

en.title: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus calls for sovereign equality and status
en.summary: The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus has called on the international community to reaffirm its inherent rights to sovereign equality and equal international status.

en.title: Historic margin for Fenerbahçe over Eyüpspor
en.summary: Fenerbahçe defeated Eyüpspor 8-0 at home in the 6th week of Trendyol Super League, with Vedat Muriqi scoring four goals in the commanding victory.

stories.title: Barzani: Devlet kontrolü dışındaki tüm silahlar toplanmalı

en.title: Barzani: All weapons outside state control must be collected
en.summary: The Prime Minister of Iraq's Kurdish Regional Government stated that the rule of law must prevail throughout Iraq and all weapons outside government and legitimate authority control must be collected.

en.title: Trump: I am at the decision-making stage on Iran
en.summary: US President Donald Trump stated he is deciding on Iran policy, citing options including complete elimination, economic deterioration, or reaching an agreement. Trump expressed openness to meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian at the United Nations General Assembly.
